subject: Supplier portal: Tax ID validation & PO remittance mapping issue
body:
From: Susan Perez <susan.perez@bluepeak.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 15:08:00 -0800
Subject: Supplier portal signup failing - Tax ID format and PO remittance

Hi Vanessa,

I'm trying to complete BluePeak's supplier registration in your Coupa portal but the form keeps rejecting our Tax ID even though it's formatted exactly like our W-9 (NN-NNNNNNN). The field gives a validation error: "Invalid Tax ID format: only digits allowed". I've attached a screenshot of the error.

Also, when I try to map our remittance address for PO routing the portal offers two existing remittance options (HQ vs Billing) but neither maps to the ERP location on our invoices — when I select Billing the test PO created in the portal still routes to HQ. That will break automated PO → invoice matching on our side.

Can you advise the correct Tax ID format and whether your Coupa instance supports custom remittance-to-ERP mapping per vendor site? We have a pending purchase order and need setup completed before the end of next week.

Thanks,
Susan Perez
Senior Vendor Operations
BluePeak Logistics
attachment: screenshot-taxid-error.png (image/png)

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Susan Perez <susan.perez@bluepeak.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 18:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Supplier portal signup failing - Tax ID format and PO remittance

Hi Susan — thanks for the heads up and for the screenshot, that helps. Short answers up front: 1) Coupa validation on our tenant is currently stripping non-numeric characters server-side, but a recent validation rule is misfiring and rejecting hyphens — please try entering the Tax ID with no hyphens (NNNNNNNNN) for now. 2) For remittance mapping, our default site mapping is tied to the vendor's primary remit address; custom per-site ERP routing is supported but requires a quick mapping change on our end (I need Procurement to apply a remittance override to the vendor site record).

Action items:
- Susan: please upload a PDF copy of your W-9 or sign via the DocuSign link below so we can store the verified tax record (I've created a DocuSign request).
- Laura (cc): can you confirm you can open a remittance mapping change ticket with Coupa support and scope it as "vendor site override - BluePeak"? If we can get Coupa to accept the remittance code XYZ-ERP instead of HQ, that should resolve PO routing.
- Marcus (cc): once Laura confirms, schedule the mapping change and mark it as high priority — BluePeak has an urgent PO.

DocuSign W-9 request: https://docusign.net/BluePeak/W9-request-12345
Coupa ticket (placeholder): https://support.coupa.com/ticket/RED-7892

I'll hold the PO until we confirm the mapping change or provide a workaround.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0186

---
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Dec 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Supplier portal signup failing - Tax ID format and PO remittance

LAURA / MARCUS — forwarding BluePeak's note and my reply. TL;DR: portal validation is rejecting hyphens; vendor will submit W-9 via DocuSign. More importantly, their PO routing is mapping to our HQ remit instead of their ERP site.

Please confirm the following by EOD Monday:
1) Laura: open a remittance override ticket with Coupa (include vendor site ID and request code XYZ-ERP). Use RED-7892 as the internal reference.
2) Marcus: if Coupa needs any sample PO/invoice pairing, ask BluePeak to send a masked invoice showing the ERP remit code. We need the mapping change in place before we approve the next invoice.

Copy of vendor request is below for context. I flagged this as time-sensitive because the PO hold affects our integration timeline for the customer deployment. If either of you hit blockers, escalate to Procurement ops and loop in legal for any W-9 retention questions.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
